branches.if: $.args.name in ["Apple", "Google", "Tesla", "Microsoft", "Nvidia", "Zeta Corp", "Alpha Tech", "Omega Industries", "Quasar Ltd.", "Neptune Systems", "Synex Solutions", "Amazon", "Gorilla"]
branches.description: The provided company name exists in the hardcoded symbol_map and the matching stock symbol is returned.
The provided company name is not found in the hardcoded symbol_map, so the tool returns the 'Stock not found' message without an error.

fields.logic: Symbol selected from the hardcoded company-name-to-symbol map based on the provided company name.
Hardcoded fallback message returned when the company name is not in the symbol map.
